entities.summary: Prince Nikolai Sergeyevich Trubetzkoy was a Russian linguist and historian whose teachings formed a nucleus of the Prague School of structural linguistics. He is widely considered to be the founder of morphophonology. He was also associated with the Russian Eurasianists. Nikolai Trubetzkoy was a writers & intellectuals from Moscow (1890-04-16, Moscow–1938-06-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
